customManagers.description: The darwin Go toolchain pin: a Mavergreen/golang-127 release tag, bare.
The Go that builds the Linux binary and the darwin/arm64 slice: upstream Go, bare version.

packageRules.description: Not an automerge exception: the family default (ship-if-green) still applies. This only keeps upstream Go on the 1.27 line the darwin toolchain pin is on, so the two Gos never diverge by a minor.
